verdict.rationale: Plaid documents Link as the single client-side component users go through to connect their accounts for API access. The Sandbox endpoint accepts "initial products" (plural) for one Item, which implies several products attach to one connection. A community comment independently notes that a single Plaid flow exposes transactions, identity and real-time balance together. However, the evidence never explicitly documents configuring one Link session or token to enable Auth, Balance, Transactions and Identity at once. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs on requesting multiple products in a single Link token, guidance on adding products to an existing Item without relinking, hands-on developer corroboration.
